Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
Stops the "rate this app" prompt after checkout.

Shows details the app receives but hides: ticket lottery applicant and ticket counts and results dates, when ticket sales close for each time slot, facility booking window rules, your lottery confirmation deadlines, and venue booking times…
